canada.title: Man from India accused of kidnapping, sexual assault of woman held hostage in Airdrie
canada.summary: A man from India, in Canada on a visitor visa, has been charged with sexual assault, kidnapping and more after being arrested during a hostage standoff north of Calgary.

canada.title: After months of delays, YWCA N.W.T. sets new date for annual general meeting
canada.summary: In a news release Thursday, YWCA N.W.T.'s board of directors said the delays were necessary to allow time for an independent review of the organization to take place.

canada.title: Winnipeggers book their tickets to Vice City with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI
canada.summary: Lee Stewart and all his staff are taking a vacation from the chilly autumn streets of Winnipeg and heading for the sunny coast of Vice City, the fictitious setting of the latest Rockstar Games release, Grand Theft Auto VI. They're far from alone.

canada.title: Dozens gather at Yukon legislature building to protest end of rent control, return of no-cause evictions
canada.summary: About 50 people gathered outside the Jim Smith building in Whitehorse on Thursday, protesting recent amendments to the territory’s Residential Tenancies Act which removed the rent cap and brought back no-cause evictions.

canada.title: Pedestrian dead after being struck by vehicle in Mississauga, police say
canada.summary: A pedestrian is dead after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga on Thursday evening, police say.

canada.title: Former top Mountie, guilty of rec centre teen assault, gets conditional discharge
canada.summary: A former high-ranking B.C. RCMP officer has been granted a conditional discharge in an assault case stemming from an incident at the Abbotsford Recreation Centre in the summer of 2025.

canada.title: Semi driver fined $12,600 for hitting Saskatoon overpass
canada.summary: The City of Saskatoon announced that a semi-driver responsible for one of the many overpass strikes this year pleaded guilty to a traffic bylaw charge and was fined $12,600.

canada.title: Outgoing Green Party leader says Carney is the most ‘opaque, unaccountable person in politics’
canada.summary: Outgoing Green Party leader Elizabeth May says Prime Minister Mark Carney is not being held to account for his actions as leader.

canada.title: Alberta bill would ban some bike lanes, let transportation minister remove others
canada.summary: Alberta’s government is proposing to ban future bike lanes that remove or restrict motor-vehicle traffic and give itself the power to remove some existing bike lanes.

canada.title: Sask. auditor to investigate allegations of fraud, falsifying records at Lumsden recovery centre
canada.summary: The EHN Willowview facility in Lumsden, northwest of Regina, receives more than $7 million a year through a contract with the Saskatchewan government.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge shooter used ChatGPT to build 3D gun parts, U.S. magazine reports
canada.summary: Mother Jones reports that ChatGPT helped killer Jesse Van Rootselaar make a 3D-printed gun magazine and foregrip, and gave advice on how to fix a spring, before the deadly mass shooting on Feb. 10.

canada.title: Donations pour in for residents displaced by Glace Bay fire and explosion
canada.summary: The community of Glace Bay, N.S. in Cape Breton is coming together to support those affected by a devastating fire and explosion on Commercial Street.

canada.title: Chow shakes up city hall leadership, taps former Liberal MP for housing
canada.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow is again turning down a post on the Toronto police board while opting to stick with the same roster of deputy mayors as when she finished her first term.
canada.outlet: CP24 + Global News (CP), CBC News, CityNews

canada.title: Quebecers suspected of murder among Canada's 25 most wanted fugitives
canada.summary: Three men suspected of murder in Quebec have been added to the list of Canada's top 25 most wanted fugitives. The updated list was unveiled on Thursday in Toronto as part of the BOLO (Be On the Lookout) program.

canada.title: Weight balance, fuel concerns highlighted in report on deadly 2025 Manitoba plane crash
canada.summary: An investigation into a plane crash that killed four in northern Manitoba last year has raised concerns about weight balance and fuel storage on a flight that almost didn't happen.

canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.
canada.outlet: CBC News, CP24, CP24 + Global News (CP)

canada.title: Top court won’t hear bid for class-action lawsuit on behalf of Indigenous children
canada.summary: The Supreme of Court of Canada will not hear a bid to certify a class-action lawsuit against Ottawa on behalf of Indigenous children

canada.title: Anthropic needs rapid growth to keep up spending, as Canadian AI sector heats up
canada.summary: Anthropic's investor documents warn the company needs to increase sales to pay for its data centre leases and infrastructure. At the same time, the company says it needs to plan its data centre investments years in advance, without knowing whether its customers will be there for the long term.

bds.lede: Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for a meeting that was big on symbolism but lacking in substance.
rows: President Trump will speak Friday about the meeting he had this week with Russia's Vladimir Putin and China's Xi Jinping. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has more on that and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's meeting with U.S. envoys and European leaders.

It was the summit seen around the world. The first-ever trilateral meeting between the leaders of the United States, China and Russia resulted in a joint statement that included promises to release more oil and hold formal talks about nuclear weapons. Nick Schifrin reports from Shenzhen.
Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for a meeting that was big on symbolism but lacking in substance.

Explosions rocked Kyiv at around 1:25 a.m. on Nov. 20, according to Kyiv Independent journalists on the ground. Earlier, monitoring channels reported that Russia had launched Tu-160 strategic bombers.
The West has been trying to isolate the Russian leader for years.
His embrace of the U.S.’s foremost geopolitical rivals further undercut the president’s standing with American allies and national-security hawks.
